signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Some players thrive on making defenders look silly. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their fakeout rate on the next juke, spin or hurdle.
Receivers with this ability make sharper cuts and frequently win contested catches when covered by linebackers and linemen.
Ballcarriers with this ability will hold onto the ball if tackled during a hurdle
Ballcarriers with this ability will replenish a portion of their stamina upon successfully performing any skill move
After securing a RAC catch, ballcarriers with this ability can quickly shift momentum, change direction, and turn the corner without sacrificing speed.
Players with this ability are harder to knock out of The Zone
Ballcarriers with this ability will frequently attempt to gain extra yards while being tackled
When in the red zone, receivers with this ability have a better chance to win contested catches against single coverage.
When lined up in the slot, receivers with this ability make faster cuts and have better hands when catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS
Players with this ability will distract defenders for longer with their runoffs
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Players with this ability will recover from the effects of fatigue at an increased rate between plays.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable spin animations.
